patch_description: The previous SLSQP program (max dmin s.t. dmax ≤ 1) reached 0.98, while the current softmin/softmax pipeline only reaches 0.88. The soft-min/max surrogate smooths the objective and stalls away from the true ratio. Key insight: under the constraint dmax ≤ 1, the ratio dmin/dmax equals exactly the minimized dmin, so the constrained problem directly optimizes the true metric. I add a SLSQP stage (maximize min distance subject to max distance ≤ 1) applied to the top-ranked candidates from the cheap ranking pass, plus a final SLSQP polish of the best free-space point (after normalizing so dmax ≈ 1). This combines the good global search of the surrogate pipeline with the exact constrained optimizer that previously scored 0.98.
